title: Impacts of global warming on subnational poverty and inequality
Assessing The Real-World Economic Value of Weather Forecasts under Compounding Extremes: A Decision-Specific Framework
venue: World Bank Policy Research Working Paper
abstract: Assessing the real-world economic value of weather forecasts remains challenging, particularly in the context of high-impact extreme events. Although meteorological skill has improved substantially in recent years—driven by steady advances in physics-based models and impressive breakthroughs in artificial intelligence-based forecasting—operational evaluations still focus primarily on standard skill metrics, with limited consideration of how improvements in meteorological skill translate into economic value. This study proposes a flexible framework to assess the economic value of weather forecasts, with penalty functions that explicitly account for compounding losses as well as declining user trust in cases of repeated false alarms. In addition, the framework allows for varying cost—loss ratios to represent heterogeneous prevention costs and vulnerability structures. The framework is applied to cities exposed to weather-related natural hazards, comparing the relative economic value of leading physics-based and data-driven forecasting systems from the European Centre for Medium-Range Weather Forecasts. The value of forecasts is highly sensitive to assumptions about compounding losses, penalty structures, and prevention costs, which often substantially alter conclusions drawn from meteorological skill alone. For instance, in some cities in Southern Europe, the higher sensitivity of the physics-based Integrated Forecast System high-resolution model (IFS HRES) makes it better suited when protection costs are small relative to potential losses, while the higher specificity of the data-driven Artificial Intelligence Forecasting System (AIFS) makes it better when protection costs are higher. These findings underscore the importance of evaluating economic value under realistic risk scenarios to ensure that improvements in predictive accuracy translate into meaningful societal and economic benefits.
abstract_zh: 评估天气预报在现实世界中的经济价值仍然具有挑战性，在高影响极端事件的背景下尤其如此。尽管近年来，基于物理的模式的持续进步以及基于人工智能的预报取得的突破性进展，使气象预报技能有了大幅提升，但业务化评估仍主要集中于标准的技能指标，很少考虑气象技能的提高如何转化为经济价值。本研究提出了一个灵活的框架来评估天气预报的经济价值，其中的惩罚函数明确考虑了复合损失，以及在反复出现误报的情况下用户信任度的下降。此外，该框架允许成本—损失比的变化，以体现异质性的防护成本和脆弱性结构。该框架被应用于暴露于天气相关自然灾害的城市，比较了欧洲中期天气预报中心领先的基于物理的预报系统和数据驱动预报系统的相对经济价值。预报的价值对复合损失、惩罚结构和防护成本的假设高度敏感，而这些假设往往会大幅改变仅从气象技能得出的结论。例如，在南欧的一些城市，基于物理的综合预报系统高分辨率模式（IFS HRES）具有较高的敏感度，因此在防护成本相对于潜在损失较小时更为适用；而数据驱动的人工智能预报系统（AIFS）具有较高的特异度，因此在防护成本较高时更为适用。这些发现强调，必须在现实的风险情景下评估经济价值，以确保预测精度的提高能够转化为有意义的社会和经济效益。

title: Global Flood Risk in the 2026/27 El Nino: An Empirical Estimate from the Historical Relationship
abstract: We estimate the response of recorded flood activity to the Niño3.4 sea-surface-temperature anomaly for 104 countries, using a monthly country panel built from EM-DAT (1980–2025) and the NOAA Niño3.4 series. Identification comes from within-country, within-calendar-month variation in the index, net of a linear trend in reporting intensity. The headline outcome is the expected number of recorded floods, estimated by quasi-Poisson regression; a logistic model of flood occurrence is reported alongside and gives near-identical answers. El Niño redistributes flood activity but does not change significantly the world total. The analysis finds an increase in the number of floods in 44 countries, with this increase significant in 10 countries. Country effects are large and geographically coherent, from 2.26 per °C in Uruguay to 0.46 in Togo. Applying the ECMWF Niño3.4 outlook against a neutral counterfactual, the expected number of recorded floods in these countries rises by 2.05× in 2026 and 2.88× in 2027. In parallel, the analysis suggests a decrease in the number of floods in 60 countries, with this decrease significant in 19 countries. In absolute terms, the countries with a positive signal are expected to record +42.9 additional floods in 2026 and +57.1 in 2027 on the main scenario, while the countries with a negative signal are expected to record 31.0 fewer floods in 2026 and 30.6 fewer in 2027. The two largely offset, leaving net changes of +11.8 and +26.5 events. As a comparison, the estimates agree in sign with the model-based El Niño flood signal of Ward et al. (2014) for 86% of the 29 countries whose estimated effect is significant. A reduced expected flood count does not imply reduced risk. The estimates describe a shift in the expected rate at which countries enter the disaster register; they place no bound on the severity of individual events. Damaging floods are recorded in every ENSO phase, and in countries with high floodplain exposure a single event within a suppressed season can exceed the annual average loss by a large margin. The results do not support any reduction in preparedness.
abstract_zh: 我们利用基于EM-DAT（1980–2025年）和美国国家海洋和大气管理局（NOAA）尼诺3.4指数序列构建的月度国家面板数据，估计了104个国家记录的洪水活动对尼诺3.4海表温度异常的响应。识别依赖于指数在国家内部、同一日历月内的变化，并扣除了报告强度的线性趋势。核心结果为洪水记录次数的期望值，采用拟泊松回归估计；同时报告了洪水发生概率的逻辑斯蒂模型，二者结果几乎一致。厄尔尼诺现象重新分配了洪水活动，但并未显著改变全球总数。分析发现，在44个国家中洪水次数增加，其中10个国家的增加效应显著。国家效应较大且在地理上具有一致性，从乌拉圭每摄氏度2.26次到多哥每摄氏度0.46次不等。以欧洲中期天气预报中心（ECMWF）的尼诺3.4预测相对于中性反事实情景进行估算，这些国家记录的洪水次数期望值在2026年将上升至2.05倍，在2027年将上升至2.88倍。与此同时，分析表明，在60个国家中洪水次数减少，其中19个国家的减少效应显著。以绝对数量计，在主要情景下，呈正向信号的国家预计在2026年多记录42.9次洪水，2027年多记录57.1次；而呈负向信号的国家预计在2026年少记录31.0次洪水，2027年少记录30.6次。两者在很大程度上相互抵消，净变化分别为增加11.8次和26.5次。作为对比，在估计效应显著的29个国家中，有86%的国家其估计结果在符号上与Ward等人（2014）基于模型得出的厄尔尼诺洪水信号一致。洪水期望次数的减少并不意味着风险的降低。这些估计刻画的是各国进入灾害登记记录的期望速率的变化；它们并不对单个事件的严重程度设定任何界限。在每一种ENSO位相中都有造成破坏的洪水被记录，而在洪泛区暴露程度较高的国家，受抑制季节中的单次事件就可能大幅超过年均损失。这些结果并不支持任何减少防灾准备的理由。

title: Growth and Debt Sustainability Trade-offs in the Presence of Climate Shocks and Uncertainties
abstract: Climate shocks create a difficult policy problem: an intervention that protects growth can also strain public finances, and these trade-offs are magnified by uncertainty about both the shocks themselves and the macroeconomic model used to assess them. In this paper, a methodology to explore these issues is presented and applied to the management of coastal flood risks in the Maldives. The analysis uses a version of the World Bank MFMod macrostructural model that includes stochastic damages from coastal flood and model uncertainty. It evaluates two policy options (prevention and preparedness) using three metrics: expected GDP losses, the probability that debt exceeds a sustainability threshold, and the probability of a sharp deterioration in the debt ratio. Results show that climate risks are macro-critical in the Maldives and that individual policies create synergies and trade-offs. Investments in prevention are win-win, with gains in GDP enhancing debt sustainability, but only up to a certain level. Beyond a threshold, there is a trade-off between growth and debt sustainability as debt-financed prevention investments worsen debt vulnerabilities in spite of the GDP gains they generate. Preparedness alone (through contingency funds or other instruments) improves fiscal resilience, especially in context of large tail risks. Policy mixes mitigate trade-offs and preparedness and prevention are complement: preparedness enables larger prevention investments without magnifying debt vulnerability, leading to larger GDP gains. Introducing model uncertainty widens the distribution of possible outcomes but does not affect key policy conclusions. The main policy message is that robust climate macrofiscal planning should move beyond expected values and focus on policy mixes that combine prevention and preparedness to manage growth and debt sustainability across a wide range of plausible futures.
abstract_zh: 气候冲击带来了棘手的政策难题：保护增长的干预措施也可能使公共财政承压，而对冲击本身以及用于评估这些冲击的宏观经济模型的不确定性，又进一步放大了这些权衡。本文提出了一种探讨这些问题的方法，并将其应用于马尔代夫的沿海洪水风险管理。分析使用了世界银行MFMod宏观结构模型的一个版本，该版本纳入了沿海洪水造成的随机损害以及模型不确定性。分析使用三项指标评估了两种政策选项（预防和备灾）：预期GDP损失、债务超过可持续性阈值的概率，以及债务率急剧恶化的概率。结果表明，气候风险在马尔代夫具有宏观关键性，单项政策之间既存在协同效应，也存在权衡。预防性投资实现了双赢：GDP增长提高了债务可持续性，但这只在一定水平之内成立。超过某一门槛之后，增长与债务可持续性之间就会出现权衡，因为以债务融资的预防性投资尽管带来了GDP增长，却加剧了债务脆弱性。单独的备灾措施（通过应急基金或其他工具）能够改善财政韧性，在存在巨大尾部风险的情况下尤为有效。政策组合能够缓解权衡，备灾与预防是互补的：备灾使得更大规模的预防性投资成为可能，而不会放大债务脆弱性，从而带来更大的GDP增长。引入模型不确定性会拓宽可能结果的分布范围，但并不影响关键的政策结论。主要的政策信息是，稳健的气候宏观财政规划应超越期望值的视角，转而关注将预防与备灾相结合的政策组合，以便在各种合理的未来情景下管理增长与债务可持续性。

title: Modeling Supply-Chain and Transport Resilience to Climate Risks: Lessons from Four Regions
abstract: Building resilience to natural hazards requires more than identifying critical assets. It requires understanding how supply chains respond to disruptions: where suppliers are located, what inventories firms hold, how diversified their sourcing is, and how products are transported. This paper summarizes key insights from DisruptSC, a spatial agent-based model that jointly represents the transport network and firm-level supply chains, applied to four countries or regions: Tanzania, Cambodia, Ecuador, and the Middle Corridor (Central Asia and South Caucasus). Five policy-relevant findings emerge. First, the duration of a disruption is a primary driver of total economic losses, making fast recovery a crucial lever for risk reduction. Second, the distribution of direct damages across firms and facilities matters as much as the total damages in determining total economic losses. Third, compounding events striking in close succession amplify losses in non-trivial ways, so that individual events cannot be assessed in isolation. Fourth, shorter supply chains do not always increase resilience: they buffer small, frequent disruptions but amplify large ones, reflecting a trade-off between efficiency and resilience that depends on the characteristics of the firm network and the nature of the risks. And fifth, resilience is a network externality—its benefits spill across firms and across borders — so markets under-provide it, and coordinated policy, within and between countries, has a role to play. The paper also illustrates how the model can be used for operational risk assessments or investment prioritization through transport investment stress testing, hotspot identification, and cost-benefit analyses that capture supply chain impacts.
abstract_zh: 增强对自然灾害的韧性，不仅需要识别关键资产，还需要理解供应链如何应对中断：供应商位于何处、企业持有多少库存、其采购来源的多元化程度如何，以及产品如何运输。本文总结了DisruptSC模型的主要发现。该模型是一个空间智能体模型，同时刻画了运输网络和企业层面的供应链，并被应用于四个国家或地区：坦桑尼亚、柬埔寨、厄瓜多尔以及中亚走廊（中亚和南高加索地区）。研究得出了五项与政策相关的发现。第一，中断的持续时间是经济总损失的首要驱动因素，因此快速恢复是降低风险的关键杠杆。第二，直接损害在企业和设施之间的分布，与损害总量同样重要，二者共同决定了经济总损失。第三，接连发生的复合事件会以不容忽视的方式放大损失，因此不能孤立地评估单个事件。第四，较短的供应链并不总能增强韧性：它们能够缓冲小规模、高频的中断，却会放大大规模的中断，这反映了效率与韧性之间的权衡，而这种权衡取决于企业网络的特征和风险的性质。第五，韧性是一种网络外部性——其收益会溢出到企业之间和国界之外——因此市场提供的韧性不足，国家内部及国家之间的协调性政策具有作用空间。本文还说明了该模型如何用于运营风险评估或投资优先排序，包括运输投资压力测试、热点识别，以及能够反映供应链影响的成本效益分析。

title: One-Fifth of the World's Population Is at High Risk of Climate-Related Hazards
venue: World Bank Policy Research Working Paper
abstract: Climate change is increasing the frequency and intensity of extreme weather events. When these events occur, they threaten lives and livelihoods. Here we estimate the global population at high risk from climate-related hazards by examining household level vulnerability and local exposure to four types of events: droughts, floods, heatwaves and cyclones. Under current climate conditions, 4.5 billion people are expected to experience these hazards at intensities exceeding critical thresholds within their lifetime. One third of this population is considered highly vulnerable, based on seven dimensions that influence potential welfare impacts: income, education, access to finance, social protection, drinking water, electricity, and access to services and markets. Overall, we estimate that 1 in 5 people globally are at high risk from these hazards meaning that they are likely to experience them and would struggle to recover from their impacts. While the proportion of the population at high risk has nearly halved since 2010 due to decreased vulnerability, the number of people exposed has increased, and progress has been uneven across regions. This study demonstrates how household survey and high-resolution spatial data can be used to consistently track climate risks across countries and over time. The findings are relevant for policymakers working on climate change adaptation strategies.
abstract_zh: 气候变化正在增加极端天气事件的频率和强度。这些事件发生时，会威胁人们的生命和生计。本文通过考察家庭层面的脆弱性，以及当地对四类事件（干旱、洪水、热浪和气旋）的暴露程度，估算了全球处于气候相关灾害高风险之中的人口。在当前气候条件下，预计45亿人在其一生中会经历强度超过关键阈值的这些灾害。基于影响潜在福利后果的七个维度——收入、教育、金融可及性、社会保护、饮用水、电力以及获得服务和市场的机会——其中三分之一的人口被认为具有高度脆弱性。总体而言，我们估计全球每5人中就有1人面临这些灾害的高风险，这意味着他们很可能会经历这些灾害，并且难以从其影响中恢复。自2010年以来，处于高风险中的人口比例因脆弱性下降几乎减半，但暴露人口的数量却有所增加，而且各地区的进展并不均衡。本研究展示了如何利用住户调查和高分辨率空间数据，在各国之间以及随时间推移一致地追踪气候风险。研究结果与制定气候变化适应战略的政策制定者相关。

title: The Poverty Cost of Greenhouse Gas Emissions
venue: World Bank Policy Research Working Paper
abstract: Economic growth is the key driver of poverty reduction. At the same time, economic growth still increases greenhouse gas emissions, which are expected to increase poverty in the future. To quantify the combined effect of these two mechanisms, this paper introduces emissions-adjusted poverty, a new measure that sums a country’s poverty with the future global poverty that the country’s emissions will create. The measure reaches zero when poverty is eliminated within a country and its emissions hit net-zero. Its key parameter is a human-centric analogue to the social cost of carbon, quantifying how current emissions raise future global poverty. The paper estimates that each kiloton of carbon dioxide emitted today adds two person-years of extreme poverty globally between now and 2100. Despite large uncertainties, the paper identifies two robust insights. For poor countries, poverty reduction from economic growth outweighs future global poverty added from the emissions associated with this growth, even with historical carbon intensities. In contrast, for many rich countries, the climate-related cost of growth outweighs the benefits unless the carbon intensity of growth falls. In all countries, the poverty gains from economic growth are larger with lower carbon intensities.
abstract_zh: 经济增长是减贫的关键驱动力。与此同时，经济增长仍会增加温室气体排放，而这些排放预计将在未来加剧贫困。为量化这两种机制的综合效应，本文提出了“排放调整后贫困”这一新指标，它将一个国家的贫困水平与该国排放将在未来造成的全球贫困相加。当一国国内消除贫困且其排放达到净零时，该指标为零。其关键参数是社会碳成本以人为中心的类比物，用于量化当前排放如何增加未来的全球贫困。本文估计，今天每排放1千吨二氧化碳，到2100年之前将在全球范围内增加两人年的极端贫困。尽管存在较大的不确定性，本文仍识别出两个稳健的结论。对于贫穷国家而言，即使按历史碳强度计算，经济增长带来的减贫效应也超过了与这种增长相关的排放所增加的未来全球贫困。相比之下，对于许多富裕国家而言，除非增长的碳强度下降，否则增长带来的气候相关成本将超过其收益。在所有国家中，碳强度越低，经济增长带来的减贫效益就越大。

title: Optimal Allocation of Abatement Effort Under Political Constraints: The Economic Cost of Delaying Sectoral and Economy-Wide Climate Policies
abstract: Despite commitments to address climate change, governments face political challenges to implementing first-best policies. These challenges cause policymakers to delay climate action, especially in politically sensitive sectors of the economy. Taking political headwinds as an exogenous constraint, this paper analyzes the cost of delaying climate policies both at a sectoral level and economy-wide. The paper demonstrates that delaying climate action is more expensive than distorting the allocation of effort across sectors. More precisely, it is more expensive to delay economy-wide climate policies than to delay action only in a subset of sensitive sectors, which is, in turn, more expensive than immediately implementing a less ambitious policy (e.g., a lower-than-optimal carbon price) in sensitive sectors. The paper then uses numerical simulations to show that sectoral emissions rates, rather than abatement costs, drive the cost of delaying climate action in a given sector. This is because delaying action in sectors with high emissions rates causes a large distortion in the allocation of effort across the rest of the economy, which increases costs. Failing to capture low cost abatement opportunities does increase policy costs (because it requires doing more in expensive sectors) but this effect is smaller than delaying high emissions sectors. Finally, the paper shows that, in practice, climate action is most expensive to delay in the energy sector, because it possesses both a high emissions rate and a low marginal investment cost. The paper can provide guidance for policymakers navigating the political-economic landscape while still aiming to achieve climate goals.
abstract_zh: 尽管各国都承诺应对气候变化，但政府在实施最优政策方面仍面临政治挑战。这些挑战导致决策者推迟气候行动，尤其是在经济中政治敏感的部门。本文将政治阻力视为外生约束，分别从部门层面和全经济层面分析了推迟气候政策的成本。本文证明，推迟气候行动的代价高于扭曲各部门之间的减排努力配置。更确切地说，推迟全经济层面的气候政策，比仅推迟一部分敏感部门的行动代价更高；而后者又比在敏感部门立即实施力度较小的政策（例如低于最优水平的碳价格）代价更高。随后，本文通过数值模拟表明，在给定部门中，推迟气候行动的成本是由部门排放率而非减排成本所驱动的。这是因为，推迟排放率较高部门的行动，会对经济其余部分的减排努力配置造成较大扭曲，从而推高成本。未能抓住低成本减排机会确实会提高政策成本（因为需要在昂贵的部门做更多减排），但这一效应小于推迟高排放部门行动所带来的影响。最后，本文表明，在实践中，推迟能源部门的气候行动成本最高，因为该部门兼具高排放率和低边际投资成本。本文可以为政策制定者在政治经济环境中把握方向、同时仍努力实现气候目标提供指导。

title: Climate Policies are Path-Dependent: Implications for Policy Sequencing and Feasibility
venue: World Bank Policy Research Working Paper
abstract: Although the feasibility of introducing climate policies underpins global efforts to curb climate change, there has been limited analysis estimating the likelihood of introducing specific policies in different country contexts. Drawing on a dataset of climate policies introduced globally over the past 50 years, this paper explores patterns in climate policy adoption to quantify policy feasibility across countries. In constructing a ‘Climate Policy Space’ network based on the co-occurrence of policies across countries, the paper shows that climate policy adoption is path-dependent: countries are significantly more likely to introduce policies that are related to their prior climate policymaking experience. Exploiting this finding, the paper constructs empirically validated ‘Climate Policy Feasibility Frontiers’ which identify policies that are likely to be more feasible and could also increase the probability of the adoption of other policies. Complementing traditional cost-benefit analysis, feasibility frontiers can inform more realistic and strategic climate policy prioritization across countries.
abstract_zh: 尽管引入气候政策的可行性是全球遏制气候变化努力的基础，但对于在不同国家背景下引入具体政策的可能性进行估计的分析仍然有限。本文利用过去50年全球引入的气候政策数据集，探讨气候政策采纳的模式，以量化各国的政策可行性。在基于各国政策共现关系构建“气候政策空间”网络的过程中，本文表明，气候政策的采纳具有路径依赖性：各国引入与其既往气候政策制定经验相关的政策的可能性显著更高。利用这一发现，本文构建了经实证检验的“气候政策可行性前沿”，用以识别更具可行性的政策，这些政策还可能提高采纳其他政策的概率。作为对传统成本—收益分析的补充，可行性前沿能够为各国更加现实、更具战略性的气候政策优先排序提供参考。

title: Global Socio-economic Resilience to Natural Disasters
venue: World Bank Policy Research Working Paper
abstract: Most disaster risk assessments use the damages to physical assets as their central metric, often neglecting distributional impacts and the coping and recovery capacity of affected people. To address this shortcoming, the concepts of well-being losses and socio-economic resilience—the ability to experience asset losses without a decline in well-being—have been proposed. Here, we use microsimulations to produce a global estimate of well-being losses from, and socio-economic resilience to, natural disasters, covering 132 countries. On average, each $1 in disaster-related asset losses results in well-being losses equivalent to a $2 uniform national drop in consumption, with significant variation within and across countries. The poorest income quintile within each country incurs only 9% of national asset losses but accounts for 33% of well-being losses. Compared to high-income countries, low-income countries experience 67% greater well-being losses per dollar of asset losses and require 56% more time to recover. Socio-economic resilience is uncorrelated with exposure or vulnerability to natural hazards. A 10 percent increase in GDP per capita is associated with a 0.9 percentage point gain in resilience, but this benefit arises indirectly—such as through higher rate of formal employment, better financial inclusion, and broader social protection coverage—rather than from higher income itself. We assess ten policy options and find that socio-economic and financial interventions (such as insurance and social protection) can effectively complement asset-focused measures (e.g., construction standards) and that interventions targeting low-income populations usually have higher returns in terms of avoided well-being losses per dollar invested.
abstract_zh: 大多数灾害风险评估以实物资产的损失作为核心指标，往往忽视了分配效应以及受影响人群的应对和恢复能力。为弥补这一不足，学界提出了福利损失和社会经济韧性的概念——即在遭受资产损失的情况下，福利不发生下降的能力。本文利用微观模拟，对132个国家因自然灾害造成的福利损失及社会经济韧性进行了全球估计。平均而言，每1美元的灾害相关资产损失，会造成相当于全国消费统一下降2美元的福利损失，且国家内部和国家之间存在显著差异。每个国家最贫困的收入五分位组仅承担全国资产损失的9%，却占福利损失的33%。与高收入国家相比，低收入国家每损失1美元资产所遭受的福利损失高出67%，恢复所需时间多出56%。社会经济韧性与自然灾害的暴露度或脆弱性之间不存在相关性。人均GDP每增长10%，韧性提高0.9个百分点，但这一收益是间接产生的——例如通过更高的正规就业率、更好的金融包容性和更广泛的社会保护覆盖——而非来自收入本身的提高。我们评估了十种政策选项，发现社会经济和金融干预措施（例如保险和社会保护）能够有效补充以资产为核心的措施（例如建筑标准），并且针对低收入人群的干预通常每投入一美元所能避免的福利损失回报更高。

title: Does global warming worsen poverty and inequality? An updated review
Measuring Total Carbon Pricing
abstract: While countries increasingly commit to pricing greenhouse gases directly through carbon taxes or emissions trading systems, indirect forms of carbon pricing—such as fuel excise taxes and fuel subsidy reforms—remain important factors affecting the mitigation incentives in an economy. Taken together, how can policy makers think about the overall price signal for carbon emissions and the incentive it creates This paper develops a methodology for calculating a total carbon price applied to carbon emissions in a sector, fuel, or the whole economy. It recognizes that rarely is a single carbon price applied across an economy; many direct carbon pricing instruments target specific sectors or even fuels, much like indirect taxes on fossil fuels; and carbon and fuel taxes can be substituted one for another. Tracking progress on carbon pricing thus requires following both kinds of price interventions, their coverage, and specific exemptions. This inclusive total carbon pricing measure can facilitate progress in discussions on minimum carbon price commitments and inform assessments of the pricing of carbon embodied in traded goods. Calculations across 142 countries from 1991 to 2021 indicate that although direct carbon pricing now covers roughly a quarter of global emissions, the global total carbon price is not that much higher than it was in 1994 when the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change entered into force. Indirect carbon pricing still comprises the lion’s share of the global total carbon price, and it has stagnated. Taking these policy measures into account reveals that many developing countries—particularly net fuel importers—contribute substantially to global carbon pricing. Tackling fuel subsidy reform and pricing coal and natural gas emissions more fully would have a profound effect on aligning carbon prices across countries and sectors and with their climate costs.
abstract_zh: 尽管各国日益承诺通过碳税或排放交易体系直接为温室气体定价，但燃油消费税和燃料补贴改革等间接形式的碳定价，仍然是影响经济体减排激励的重要因素。综合来看，政策制定者应如何看待碳排放的整体价格信号，及其所产生的激励？本文提出了一种方法，用于计算适用于某一部门、某种燃料或整个经济体碳排放的总碳价格。该方法认识到：很少有单一的碳价格适用于整个经济体；许多直接碳定价工具仅针对特定部门甚至特定燃料，与化石燃料间接税的情形类似；而碳税与燃料税之间可以相互替代。因此，跟踪碳定价的进展需要同时考察这两类价格干预措施、它们的覆盖范围以及具体的豁免情况。这一涵盖面广的总碳价格指标，有助于推动关于最低碳价格承诺的讨论，并为评估贸易商品中所含碳的定价提供信息。对1991年至2021年142个国家的计算表明，尽管直接碳定价目前覆盖了全球约四分之一的排放，但全球总碳价格并不比1994年《联合国气候变化框架公约》生效时高出多少。间接碳定价仍占全球总碳价格的绝大部分，且已停滞不前。将这些政策措施纳入考量后可以发现，许多发展中国家——尤其是燃料净进口国——对全球碳定价作出了实质性贡献。推进燃料补贴改革，并更全面地为煤炭和天然气排放定价，将对使各国和各部门之间的碳价格以及碳价格与其气候成本保持一致产生深远影响。

title: Modeling the macroeconomic consequences of natural disasters: Capital stock, recovery dynamics, and monetary policy
How Delayed Learning about Climate Uncertainty Impacts Decarbonization Investment Strategies
venue: World Bank Policy Research Working Paper
abstract: The Paris Agreement established that global warming should be limited to “well below” 2°C and encouraged efforts to limit warming to 1.5°C. Achieving this goal presents a challenge, especially given (i) economic inertia and adjustment costs, which penalize a swift transition away from fossil fuels, and (ii) climate uncertainty that, for example, hinders the ability to predict the amount of emissions that can be released before a given temperature target is exceeded. This paper presents a modeling framework that explores optimal decarbonization investment strategy when both adjustment costs and climate uncertainty are present. The findings show that climate uncertainty impacts investment in three ways: (i) the cost of policy increases, especially when adjustment costs are present; (ii) abatement investment is front-loaded relative to the certainty policy; and (iii) the sectoral allocation of investment changes to favor declining investment pathways rather than bell-shaped paths. The latter effect is especially pronounced in hard-to-abate sectors, such as heavy industry. Each of these effects can be traced back to the carbon price distribution inheriting a “heavy tail” when climate uncertainty is present. The paper highlights how climate uncertainty and adjustment costs combined result in a more aggressive least-cost strategy for decarbonization investment
abstract_zh: 《巴黎协定》确立了将全球变暖幅度限制在“远低于”2°C以内，并鼓励努力将升温限制在1.5°C以内的目标。实现这一目标面临挑战，尤其是考虑到：（i）经济惯性和调整成本，它们会对迅速摆脱化石燃料的转型造成不利影响；以及（ii）气候不确定性，例如，它妨碍了人们预测在超过某一温度目标之前还能排放多少温室气体。本文提出了一个建模框架，用于探讨当调整成本和气候不确定性同时存在时的最优脱碳投资策略。研究发现，气候不确定性以三种方式影响投资：（i）政策成本增加，在存在调整成本时尤为明显；（ii）相对于确定性政策情形，减排投资被提前；（iii）行业投资配置发生变化，更倾向于下降型的投资路径，而非钟形路径。后一效应在重工业等难以减排的行业中尤为显著。上述每一种效应都可以追溯到以下事实：当存在气候不确定性时，碳价格分布会继承一条“厚尾”。本文强调了气候不确定性与调整成本相结合，如何导致一种更为激进的脱碳投资最低成本策略。

title: Macroeconomic implications of a transition to net zero emissions
venue: Peterson Institute for International Economics Working Paper
abstract: In 2022 the World Bank Group launched a new core diagnostic tool: the Country Climate and Development Report (CCDR). Published for 42 economies so far, CCDRs use resilient and low-emission development scenarios to identify synergies and tradeoffs between development and climate objectives. There are several modeling challenges associated with the analysis of the macroeconomic consequences of these development pathways, including those related to the nonmarginal nature of the required transformation, the role of technologies, and the replacement of fossil fuel-based assets with greener ones. To address some of these challenges, several CCDRs have used a hybrid modeling approach that combines a set of sectoral analyses with macroeconomic models. Specifically, sectoral techno-economic models are employed to construct resilient and low-emission development trajectories in key sectors. The macroeconomic implications of these sectoral transitions are then assessed by linking the sectoral models with two macroeconomic frameworks: a multisector general equilibrium framework and an aggregate macrostructural model. This hybrid approach combines the advantages of multiple tools and captures the various dimensions of the transition, including the need to tackle multiple market failures, beyond the emissions externality; analyze price and nonprice policies and their interactions; represent explicitly the replacement of assets and infrastructure; assess the macroeconomic feasibility of the sectoral transitions and the required investments. This paper uses the case of Turkey to describe the methodological approach and summarizes the results of the CCDRs that have been published to date. Findings suggest that, despite large investment needs, the transition can contribute positively to economic growth, especially when indirect mitigation benefits are taken into account, but only if structural challenges can be managed, climate and development policies are well designed, and negative impacts on some sectors or communities are mitigated.
abstract_zh: 2022年，世界银行集团推出了一项新的核心诊断工具：国家气候与发展报告（CCDR）。目前已为42个经济体发布了此类报告，CCDR利用具有韧性和低排放的发展情景，识别发展目标与气候目标之间的协同效应和权衡。分析这些发展路径的宏观经济后果存在若干建模挑战，包括所需转型的非边际性质、技术的作用，以及以化石燃料为基础的资产被更绿色资产所替代等问题。为应对其中一些挑战，若干份CCDR采用了一种混合建模方法，即将一组部门分析与宏观经济模型结合起来。具体而言，部门技术经济模型被用于构建关键部门中具有韧性和低排放的发展轨迹。随后，通过将部门模型与两个宏观经济框架相连接来评估这些部门转型的宏观经济影响：一个多部门一般均衡框架和一个总量宏观结构模型。这种混合方法综合了多种工具的优势，并刻画了转型的多个维度，包括需要应对排放外部性之外的多重市场失灵；分析价格型和非价格型政策及其相互作用；明确刻画资产和基础设施的替代；评估各部门转型的宏观经济可行性以及所需的投资。本文以土耳其为案例，阐述了该方法论，并总结了迄今已发布的CCDR的结果。研究结果表明，尽管投资需求巨大，但转型可以对经济增长作出正面贡献，特别是在考虑间接减排效益时；但前提是结构性挑战能够得到管理，气候与发展政策设计良好，并且对某些部门或社区的负面影响得到缓解。

title: Ending extreme poverty has a negligible impact on global greenhouse gas emissions
abstract:
Growing consumption is both necessary to end extreme poverty
1
and one of the main drivers of greenhouse gas emissions
2
, creating a potential tension between alleviating poverty and limiting global warming. Most poverty reduction has historically occurred because of economic growth
3–6
, which means that reducing poverty entails increasing not only the consumption of people living in poverty but also the consumption of people with a higher income. Here we estimate the emissions associated with the economic growth needed to alleviate extreme poverty using the international poverty line of US $2.15 per day (ref.
7
). Even with historical energy- and carbon-intensity patterns, the global emissions increase associated with alleviating extreme poverty is modest, at 2.37 gigatonnes of carbon dioxide equivalent per year or 4.9% of 2019 global emissions. Lower inequality, higher energy efficiency and decarbonization of energy can ease this tension further: assuming the best historical performance, the emissions for poverty alleviation in 2050 will be reduced by 90%. More ambitious poverty lines require more economic growth in more countries, which leads to notably higher emissions. The challenge to align the development and climate objectives of the world is not in reconciling extreme poverty alleviation with climate objectives but in providing sustainable middle-income standards of living.
abstract_zh: 消费增长既是消除极端贫困的必要条件，也是温室气体排放的主要驱动因素之一，这在减贫与遏制全球变暖之间造成了潜在的张力。历史上，大多数减贫都是通过经济增长实现的，这意味着减贫不仅需要提高贫困人口的消费，也需要提高收入较高人群的消费。本文以每天2.15美元的国际贫困线为标准，估算了消除极端贫困所需经济增长所伴随的排放。即使按照历史上的能源和碳强度模式，为消除极端贫困而带来的全球排放增量也相对温和，为每年23.7亿吨二氧化碳当量，约占2019年全球排放的4.9%。降低不平等程度、提高能源效率以及能源脱碳，还可以进一步缓解这一张力：假设采用历史上的最佳表现，到2050年用于减贫的排放将减少90%。更雄心勃勃的贫困线需要更多国家实现更多的经济增长，从而导致排放显著增加。使世界的发展目标与气候目标保持一致的挑战，不在于协调消除极端贫困与气候目标，而在于提供可持续的中等收入生活水平。

title: Global evidence of rapid urban growth in flood zones since 1985
abstract: As countries urbanize, human settlements are rapidly expanding into hazardous flood zones. This study provides a global analysis of spatial urbanization patterns and the evolution of flood exposure between 1985 and 2015. Using high-resolution annual data, it shows that settlements across the world grew by 85 percent to over 1.28 million square kilometers. In the same period, settlements exposed to the highest flood hazard level increased by 122 percent. In many regions, risky growth is outpacing safe growth, particularly in East Asia, where high risk settlements have expanded 60 percent faster than safe ones. Developing countries are driving the recent growth of flood exposure: 82 percent of the 36,500 square kilometers of settlements built in the world’s highest-risk zones since 1985 are in low- and middle-income countries. In comparison, recent growth in high-income countries has been relatively slow and safe. These results document a divergence in countries’ exposure to flood hazards. Rather than adapting their exposure to climatic hazards, many countries are actively increasing their exposure.
abstract_zh: 随着各国城市化，人类居住区正迅速扩张到危险的洪泛区。本研究对1985至2015年间全球城市化空间格局及洪水暴露的演变进行了全球分析。利用高分辨率年度数据，研究表明，全球居住区增长了85%，达到超过128万平方公里。同一时期，暴露于最高洪水灾害等级的居住区增长了122%。在许多地区，危险增长的速度超过了安全增长，特别是在东亚，高风险居住区的扩张速度比安全居住区快60%。发展中国家正在推动近期洪水暴露的增长：自1985年以来，全球在最高风险区域新建的3.65万平方公里居住区中，82%位于中低收入国家。相比之下，高收入国家的近期增长相对缓慢且较为安全。这些结果表明，各国在洪水灾害暴露方面出现了分化。许多国家并未使其暴露程度适应气候灾害，反而正在积极增加这种暴露。

title: Supply chains create global benefits from improved vaccine accessibility
Counting People Exposed to, Vulnerable to, or at High Risk From Climate Shocks: A Methodology
venue: World Bank Policy Research Working Paper
abstract: Based on global datasets, 4.5 billion people were exposed to extreme weather events (flood, drought, cyclone, or heatwave) in 2019, an increase from 4 billion in 2010. Among exposed people in 2019, 2.3 billion people lived with less than $6.85 per day and about 400 million lived in extreme poverty (on less than $2.15 per day). This paper presents a methodology to estimate the number of people who are at high risk from extreme weather events, defined as the people who are exposed to these events and highly vulnerable to them. Vulnerability is proxied by a set of indicators measuring (1) the physical propensity to experience severe losses (proxied by the lack of access to basic infrastructure services, here water and electricity) and (2) the inability to cope with and recover from losses (proxied by low income, not having education, not having access to financial services and not having access to social protection). Estimates from 75 countries for which data on all indicators are available suggest that, in 2019, 42 percent of the total population (and 70 percent of people exposed) are at high risk from extreme weather shocks, if one indicator is enough to be considered as highly vulnerable. If high vulnerability is defined based on being vulnerable on two dimensions or more, then 12 percent of the total population (and 20 percent of people exposed) are at high risk from extreme weather shocks. The trend between 2010 and 2019 can be explored in a subset of countries covering 60 percent of the world population. In these countries, even though the population exposed to extreme weather events has been increasing, the number of people at high risk has declined. The exception is Sub-Saharan Africa where the number of people at high risk has increased between 2010 and 2019.
abstract_zh: 根据全球数据集，2019年有45亿人暴露于极端天气事件（洪水、干旱、气旋或热浪）之中，高于2010年的40亿人。在2019年的暴露人口中，有23亿人每天的生活费不足6.85美元，约4亿人处于极端贫困之中（每天不足2.15美元）。本文提出了一种估算极端天气事件高风险人口的方法，高风险人口定义为既暴露于这些事件又高度脆弱的人口。脆弱性由一组指标来代理，衡量以下两个方面：（1）遭受严重损失的物理倾向（以缺乏基本基础设施服务来代理，此处为饮水和电力）；以及（2）应对和从损失中恢复的能力不足（以低收入、未受教育、缺乏金融服务和缺乏社会保护来代理）。基于75个所有指标数据均可获得的国家的估算表明，如果只要满足一项指标即可被视为高度脆弱，那么在2019年，全部人口的42%（即暴露人口的70%）面临极端天气冲击的高风险。如果高度脆弱性定义为在两个或以上维度上脆弱，则全部人口的12%（即暴露人口的20%）面临极端天气冲击的高风险。在覆盖全球60%人口的一部分国家中，可以考察2010年至2019年的趋势。在这些国家中，尽管暴露于极端天气事件的人口有所增加，但高风险人口却有所减少。撒哈拉以南非洲是例外，该地区高风险人口在2010年至2019年间有所增加。

title: Efficiency and Equity in Urban Flood Management Policies: A Systematic Urban Economics Exploration
venue: World Bank Policy Research Working Paper
abstract: Flood exposure is likely to increase in the future as a direct consequence of more frequent and more intense flooding and the growth of populations and economic assets in flood-prone areas. Low-income households, which are more likely to be located in high-risk zones, will be particularly affected. This paper assesses the welfare and equity impacts of three flood management policies—risk-based insurance, zoning, and subsidized insurance—using an urban economics framework with two income groups and three potential flood locations. The paper shows that in a first-best setting, risk-based insurance maximizes social welfare. However, depending on flood characteristics, implementing a zoning policy or subsidized insurance is close to optimal and can be more feasible. Subsidizing insurance reduces upward pressure on housing rents but increases flood damage, and is recommended for rare floods occurring in a large part of a city. Zoning policies have the opposite effect, avoiding damage but increasing housing rents, and are recommended for frequent floods in small areas. The social welfare impact of choosing the wrong flood management policy depends on the location of floods relative to employment centers, with flooding close to employment centers being particularly harmful. Implementing flood management policies redistributes flood costs between high- and low-income households through land markets, irrespective of who is directly affected. As such, they are progressive in terms of equity, compared to a laissez-faire scenario with myopic anticipations, in the more common scenario where poorer populations are more exposed to urban floods. But their impacts on inequality depend on flood locations and urban configuration. For instance, in a city where floods are centrally located and low-income households live in the city center, subsidized insurance would mitigate a surge in inequality, whereas a zoning policy could substantially increase inequalities.
abstract_zh: 由于洪水更加频繁和强烈，以及易受洪水侵袭地区的人口和经济资产增长，未来洪水暴露风险可能会增加。低收入家庭更可能位于高风险区域，将受到尤为严重的影响。本文运用一个包含两个收入群体和三个潜在洪水位置的城市经济学框架，评估了三种洪水管理政策——基于风险的保险、分区管制和补贴保险——的福利和公平影响。研究表明，在最优情形下，基于风险的保险能够使社会福利最大化。然而，取决于洪水特征，实施分区管制或补贴保险接近最优，且可能更具可行性。补贴保险可以减轻房租的上涨压力，但会增加洪水损失，适用于覆盖城市大部分区域的罕见洪水。分区管制政策则产生相反的效果：避免了损失，但会推高房租，适用于小范围内的频繁洪水。选择错误的洪水管理政策对社会福利的影响，取决于洪水相对于就业中心的位置，其中靠近就业中心的洪水危害尤为严重。洪水管理政策通过土地市场在高收入和低收入家庭之间重新分配洪水成本，而不论谁是直接受影响者。因此，在较常见的情形下（较贫困人口更易受城市洪水侵害），与具有短视预期的自由放任情景相比，这些政策在公平方面具有累进性。但其对不平等的影响取决于洪水位置和城市格局。例如，在洪水集中于城市中心、低收入家庭居住在市中心的城市中，补贴保险可以缓解不平等的加剧，而分区管制则可能大幅扩大不平等。

abstract: No AccessPolicy Research Working Papers11 Aug 2021Flood Protection and Land Value Creation — not All Resilience Investments are Created EqualAuthors/Editors: Paolo Avner, Vincent Viguié, Bramka Arga Jafino, Stephane HallegattePaolo Avner, Vincent Viguié, Bramka Arga Jafino, Stephane Hallegattehttps://doi.org/10.1596/1813-9450-9744SectionsAboutPDF (4 MB) ToolsAdd to favoritesDownload CitationsTrack Citations ShareFacebookTwitterLinked In Abstract: This paper investigates the land value creation potential from flood mitigation investments in a theoretical and applied setting, using the urban area of Buenos Aires as a case study. It contributes to the literature on the wider economic benefits of government interventions and the dividends of resilience investments. Using a simple urban economics framework that represents land and housing markets, it finds that not all flood mitigation interventions display the same potential for land value creation: where land is more valuable (city centers for example), the benefits of resilience are higher. The paper also provides ranges for land value creation potential from the flood mitigation works in Buenos Aires under various model specifications. Although the estimates vary largely depending on model parameters and specifications, in many cases the land value creation would be sufficient to justify the investments. This result is robust even in the closed city configuration with conservative flood damage estimates, providing that the parameters remain reasonably close to the values obtained from the calibration. Finally, acknowledging that fully calibrating and running an urban simulation model is data greedy and time intensive—even a simple model as proposed here—this research also proposes reduced form expressions that can provide approximations for land value creation from flood mitigation investments and can be used in operational contexts. title: Bank Stress Testing of Physical Risks under Climate Change Macro Scenarios: Typhoon Risks to the Philippines
abstract: Bank stress tests of climate change risks are relatively new, but are rapidly proliferating. The IMF and World Bank staff collaborated to develop an experimental macro scenario stress testing approach to examine physical risks for banks by building a dynamic stochastic general equilibrium model linked to global climate and a catastrophe risk model specifically for the Philippines. Our model shows that the impact of extremely rare typhoons on GDP could already be systemic and worsen substantially with climate change. However, bank capital declines only modestly unless the event is compounded with other disasters, partly thanks to the strength of Philippines’ banks and economy before the COVID crisis. However, more work is needed before drawing strong conclusions about the relevance of climate risk, as the model focused only on typhoons’ physical capital destructions and their macroeconomic-level transmissions to banks.
abstract_zh: 针对气候变化风险的银行压力测试相对较新，但正在迅速普及。国际货币基金组织（IMF）与世界银行的工作人员合作，开发了一种实验性的宏观情景压力测试方法，以考察银行面临的物理风险：为此，他们构建了一个与全球气候相连接的动态随机一般均衡模型，并专门针对菲律宾建立了一个巨灾风险模型。我们的模型表明，极为罕见的台风对GDP的影响可能已经具有系统性，并会随着气候变化而大幅恶化。然而，除非该事件与其他灾害叠加，否则银行资本只会有适度的下降，部分得益于新冠疫情危机前菲律宾银行和经济的稳健性。不过，在得出关于气候风险相关性的有力结论之前，还需要开展更多工作，因为该模型仅关注台风造成的实物资本损毁及其向银行传导的宏观经济层面的影响。

'Building Back Better' in Practice: A Science-Policy Framework for a Green Economic Recovery after COVID-19
venue: World Bank Policy Research Working Paper
abstract: As humanityâ€™s current production and consumption patterns exceed planetary boundaries, many opinion leaders have stressed the need to adopt green economic stimulus policies in the aftermath of the COVID-19 pandemic, in line with the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals and the Paris Agreement on Climate Change. This paper provides an integrated framework to design an economic recovery strategy aligned with sustainability objectives through a multi-criterion, multi-stakeholder lens. The aim is to enable decisions by policy makers with the aid of transparent workflows that include expert evidence that is based on quantitative open-source modeling, and qualitative input by diverse social actors in a participatory approach. The paper employs an energy systems model and an economic input-output model to provide quantitative evidence and design a multi-criteria decision process that engages stakeholders from government, enterprises, and civil society. As a case study, the paper studies 13 green recovery measures that are relevant for Cyprus and assesses their appropriateness for criteria related to environmental sustainability, socioeconomic and job impact, and climate resilience. The results highlight trade-offs between immediate and long-run effects, between economic and environmental objectives, and between expert evidence and societal priorities. Importantly, the paper finds that a â€œreturn-to-normalâ€ economic stimulus is not only environmentally unsustainable, but also economically inferior to most green recovery schemes.
abstract_zh: 由于当前人类的生产和消费模式已超出地球的承载边界，许多意见领袖强调，在新冠疫情之后应当采取绿色经济刺激政策，以符合联合国可持续发展目标和《巴黎气候变化协定》。本文提供了一个综合框架，从多标准、多利益相关方的视角设计与可持续发展目标相一致的经济复苏战略。其目的在于，借助透明的工作流程帮助政策制定者作出决策，这些流程包括基于定量开源建模的专家证据，以及各类社会行为体以参与式方式提供的定性意见。本文运用一个能源系统模型和一个经济投入产出模型来提供定量证据，并设计了一个多标准决策过程，邀请来自政府、企业和民间社会的利益相关方参与。作为案例，本文研究了与塞浦路斯相关的13项绿色复苏措施，并就其在环境可持续性、社会经济和就业影响以及气候韧性相关标准上的适当性进行了评估。结果凸显了短期与长期效应之间、经济目标与环境目标之间，以及专家证据与社会优先事项之间的权衡。重要的是，本文发现，“回归常态”式的经济刺激不仅在环境上不可持续，而且在经济上也劣于大多数绿色复苏方案。

title: Floods and Their Impacts on Firms: Evidence from Tanzania
venue: World Bank Policy Research Working Paper
abstract: This study explores how businesses in Tanzania are impacted by floods, and which strategies they use to cope and adapt. These insights are based on firm survey data collected in 2018 using a tailored questionnaire, covering a sample of more than 800 firms. To assess the impact of disasters on businesses, the study considers direct damages and indirect effects through infrastructure systems, supply chains, and workers. While direct on-site damages from flooding can be substantial, they tend to affect a relatively small share of firms. Indirect impacts of floods are more prevalent and sizable. Flood-induced infrastructure disruptions—especially electricity and transport—obstruct the operations of firms even when they are not directly located in flood zones. The effects of such disruptions are further propagated and multiplied along supply chains. The study estimates that supply chain multipliers are responsible for 30 to 50 percent of all flood-related delivery delays. To cope with these impacts, firms apply a variety of strategies. Firms mitigate supply disruptions by adjusting the size and geographical reach of their supply networks, and by adjusting inventory holdings. By investing in costly backup capacity (such as water tanks and electricity generators), firms mitigate the impact of infrastructure disruptions. The study estimates that only 13 percent of firms receive government support in the aftermath of floods.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了坦桑尼亚的企业如何受到洪水影响，以及它们采用哪些应对和适应策略。这些见解基于2018年使用定制问卷收集的企业调查数据，样本涵盖800多家企业。为评估灾害对企业的影响，本研究考虑了直接损失以及通过基础设施系统、供应链和工人产生的间接影响。尽管洪水造成的现场直接损失可能相当严重，但其影响的企业比例相对较小。洪水的间接影响更为普遍，规模也更大。洪水引发的基础设施中断，特别是电力和交通中断，即使对不位于洪泛区的企业也会妨碍其运营。这些中断的影响会沿供应链进一步传播和放大。研究估计，供应链乘数效应造成了30%至50%的洪水相关交付延误。为应对这些影响，企业采取了多种策略。企业通过调整供应网络的规模和地理覆盖范围，以及调整库存持有量，来缓解供应中断。通过投资成本高昂的备用设施（如蓄水罐和发电机），企业减轻了基础设施中断的影响。研究估计，洪灾之后只有13%的企业获得了政府支持。

title: Revised Estimates of the Impact of Climate Change on Extreme Poverty by 2030
venue: World Bank Policy Research Working Paper
abstract: Thousands of scenarios are used to provide updated estimates for the impacts of climate changeon extreme poverty in 2030. The range of the number of people falling into poverty due to climate change is between32 million and 132 million in most scenarios. These results are commensurate with available estimates for the globalpoverty increase due to COVID-19. Socioeconomic drivers play a major role: optimistic baseline scenarios (rapid andinclusive growth with universal access to basic services in 2030) halve poverty impacts compared with the pessimisticbaselines. Health impacts (malaria, diarrhea, and stunting) and the effect of food prices are responsible for most ofthe impact. The effect of food prices is the most important factor in Sub-Saharan Africa, while health effects, naturaldisasters, and food prices are all important in South Asia. These results suggest that accelerated action to boostresilience is urgent, and the COVID-19 recovery packages offer opportunities to do so.
abstract_zh: 本文使用数千种情景，对2030年气候变化对极端贫困影响的估计进行了更新。在大多数情景下，因气候变化而陷入贫困的人数介于3,200万至1.32亿之间。这些结果与现有关于COVID-19导致全球贫困增加的估计相当。社会经济驱动因素起着重要作用：乐观的基准情景（即2030年实现快速和包容性增长并普遍获得基本服务）可使贫困影响减半，相比之下，悲观基准情景下影响则更大。健康影响（疟疾、腹泻和发育迟缓）以及粮食价格的影响是造成大部分影响的原因。粮食价格的影响在撒哈拉以南非洲是最重要的因素，而健康影响、自然灾害和粮食价格在南亚都很重要。这些结果表明，加快行动以增强韧性十分紧迫，而COVID-19后的复苏计划为此提供了机会。

title: Moral Hazard vs. Land Scarcity: Flood Management Policies for the Real World
venue: World Bank Policy Research Working Paper
abstract: This paper investigates the costs and benefits of three ex ante flood management strategies -- risk-based insurance, zoning, and subsidized insurance -- in an urban economics framework that takes land scarcity into account. In a theoretical setting and in the absence of market failures, risk-based insurance perfectly internalizes flood risks and maximizes social welfare. However, risk-based insurance faces major technical, social, and political challenges and is not always realistic. Flood zoning and subsidized insurance are two second-best options that are easier to implement and less technically demanding. The paper explores analytically and with numerical simulations the welfare losses and distributional impacts with these second-best options, and demonstrates that total losses often remain small. Flood zoning is close to optimal when flood-prone areas are small, floods are frequent, and housing quality is low. Zoning keeps total land value unchanged but transfers wealth from landowners in flood-prone areas to landowners in safe locations. Subsidized insurance is close to optimal when a large fraction of a city is flood prone, floods are rare, and housing quality is high. And although it increases flood losses through the moral hazard effect, subsidized insurance encourages more construction, which reduces housing rents and benefits tenants regardless of where they live. Subsidized insurance transfers wealth from landowners in safe locations to landowners in flood-prone areas. When the implementation of risk-based insurance is unrealistic, as is often the case in developing countries, a combination of zoning in high-risk areas and subsidized insurance for low-risk areas might be a good alternative.
abstract_zh: 本文在考虑土地稀缺性的城市经济学框架中，研究了三种事前洪水管理策略——基于风险的保险、分区管制和补贴保险——的成本与收益。在理论情境且不存在市场失灵的条件下，基于风险的保险能够完全内化洪水风险，并使社会福利最大化。然而，基于风险的保险面临重大的技术、社会和政治挑战，并不总是现实可行的。洪水分区管制和补贴保险是两种次优选择，二者更易于实施，技术要求也更低。本文通过解析和数值模拟，探讨了采用这两种次优选择时的福利损失和分配影响，并证明总损失往往较小。当洪水易发区域较小、洪水频繁且住房质量较低时，洪水分区管制接近最优。分区管制保持土地总价值不变，但将财富从洪水易发区的土地所有者转移给安全区域的土地所有者。当城市中很大比例的区域易受洪水侵袭、洪水罕见且住房质量较高时，补贴保险接近最优。尽管补贴保险会因道德风险效应而增加洪水损失，但它能鼓励更多建设，从而降低住房租金，使租户无论居住在何处都能受益。补贴保险将财富从安全区域的土地所有者转移给洪水易发区的土地所有者。当基于风险的保险难以实现时（这在发展中国家往往如此），在高风险区域实行分区管制、在低风险区域实行补贴保险的组合，可能是一个较好的替代方案。

title: Socioeconomic Resilience in Sri Lanka: Natural Disaster Poverty and Wellbeing Impact Assessment
venue: World Bank Policy Research Working Paper
abstract: Traditional risk assessments use asset losses as the main metric to measure the severity of a disaster. This paper proposes an expanded risk assessment based on a framework that adds socioeconomic resilience and uses wellbeing losses as the main measure of disaster severity. Using an agent-based model that represents explicitly the recovery and reconstruction process at the household level, this risk assessment provides new insights into disaster risks in Sri Lanka. The analysis indicates that regular flooding events can move tens of thousands of Sri Lankans into transient poverty at once, hindering the country's recent progress on poverty eradication and shared prosperity. As metrics of disaster impacts, poverty incidence and well-being losses facilitate quantification of the benefits of interventions like rapid post-disaster support and adaptive social protection systems. Such investments efficiently reduce wellbeing losses by making exposed and vulnerable populations more resilient. Nationally and on average, the bottom income quintile suffers only 7 percent of the total asset losses but 32 percent of the total wellbeing losses. Average annual wellbeing losses due to fluvial flooding in Sri Lanka are estimated at US$119 million per year, more than double the asset losses of US$78 million. Asset losses are reported to be highly concentrated in Colombo district, and wellbeing losses are more widely distributed throughout the country. Finally, the paper applies the socioeconomic resilience framework to a cost-benefit analysis of prospective adaptive social protection systems, based on enrollment in Samurdhi, the main social support system in Sri Lanka.
abstract_zh: 传统的风险评估以资产损失作为衡量灾害严重程度的主要指标。本文提出了一种扩展的风险评估方法，该方法基于一个纳入社会经济韧性的框架，并以福利损失作为衡量灾害严重程度的主要指标。本文利用一个在家庭层面明确刻画恢复和重建过程的智能体模型，对斯里兰卡的灾害风险提供了新的见解。分析表明，经常性洪水事件可能使成千上万的斯里兰卡人一次性陷入暂时性贫困，从而阻碍该国在消除贫困和共享繁荣方面取得的近期进展。作为灾害影响的衡量指标，贫困发生率和福利损失有助于量化快速灾后支持和适应性社会保护体系等干预措施的效益。此类投资通过提高暴露和脆弱人群的韧性，能够有效降低福利损失。从全国平均来看，最底层的收入五分位组仅承担全部资产损失的7%，却承担了全部福利损失的32%。斯里兰卡因河流洪水造成的年均福利损失估计为每年1.19亿美元，是资产损失7800万美元的一倍多。据报告，资产损失高度集中于科伦坡区，而福利损失则在全国范围内分布得更为广泛。最后，本文将社会经济韧性框架应用于拟议中的适应性社会保护体系的成本效益分析，该分析基于斯里兰卡主要社会支持体系Samurdhi的参保情况。

Disaster risk, climate change, and poverty: assessing the global exposure of poor people to floods and droughts
abstract: People living in poverty are particularly vulnerable to shocks, including those caused by natural disasters such as floods and droughts. Previous studies in local contexts have shown that poor people are also often overrepresented in hazard-prone areas. However, systematic evidence across countries demonstrating this finding is lacking. This paper analyzes at the country level whether poor people are disproportionally exposed to floods and droughts, and how this exposure may change in a future climate. To this end, household survey data with spatial identifiers from 52 countries are combined with present-day and future flood and drought hazard maps. The paper defines and calculates a “poverty exposure bias” and finds support that poor people are often overexposed to droughts and urban floods. For floods, no such signal is found for rural households, suggesting that different mechanisms—such as land scarcity—are more important drivers in urban areas. The poverty exposure bias does not change significantly under future climate scenarios, although the absolute number of people potentially exposed to floods or droughts can increase or decrease significantly, depending on the scenario and the region. The study finds some evidence of regional patterns: in particular, many countries in Africa exhibit a positive poverty exposure bias for floods and droughts. For these hot spots, implementing risk-sensitive land-use and development policies that protect poor people should be a priority.
abstract_zh: 贫困人口特别容易受到冲击的影响，包括洪水和干旱等自然灾害所造成的冲击。以往针对局部地区的研究表明，贫困人口在灾害易发地区中也往往占比过高。然而，目前缺乏能够跨国论证这一发现的系统性证据。本文从国家层面分析贫困人口是否不成比例地暴露于洪水和干旱之中，以及这种暴露在未来气候下可能如何变化。为此，我们将来自52个国家的带有空间标识的住户调查数据，与当前及未来的洪水和干旱灾害地图相结合。本文定义并计算了“贫困暴露偏差”，并发现贫困人口往往过度暴露于干旱和城市洪水之中。对于洪水，农村住户未发现此类信号，这表明在城市地区，土地稀缺等其他机制可能是更重要的驱动因素。在未来气候情景下，贫困暴露偏差并未发生显著变化，但可能暴露于洪水或干旱的绝对人口数量，则可能根据情景和地区的不同而显著增加或减少。研究发现了一些区域性规律的证据：特别是，非洲的许多国家在洪水和干旱方面均表现出正的贫困暴露偏差。对于这些热点地区，实施保护穷人的、对风险敏感的土地利用和发展政策应当成为优先事项。

title: Households and heat stress: estimating the distributional consequences of climate change
abstract: Recent research documents the adverse causal impacts on health and productivity of extreme heat, which will worsen with climate change. In this paper, we assess the current distribution of heat exposure within countries, to explore possible distributional consequences of climate change through temperature. Combining survey data from 690,745 households across 52 countries with spatial data on climate, this paper suggests that the welfare impacts of added heat stress may be regressivewithincountries. We find: (1) a strong negative correlation between household wealth and warmer temperature in many hot countries; (2) a strong positive correlation between household wealth and warmer temperatures in many cold countries; and (3) that poorer individuals are more likely to work in occupations with greater exposure. While our analysis is descriptive rather than causal, our results suggest a larger vulnerability of poor people to heat extremes, and potentially significant distributional and poverty implications of climate change.
abstract_zh: 近期研究记录了极端高温对健康和生产率的不利因果影响，而这一影响将随气候变化而加剧。本文评估了当前各国内部的高温暴露分布，以探讨气候变化通过温度可能产生的分配后果。本文将来自52个国家690,745户家庭的调查数据与气候空间数据相结合，发现增加的热应激对福利的影响在国家内部可能具有累退性。我们发现：（1）在许多炎热国家，家庭财富与较高温度之间存在强烈的负相关；（2）在许多寒冷国家，家庭财富与较高温度之间存在强烈的正相关；（3）较贫穷的个人更可能从事暴露程度较高的职业。尽管我们的分析是描述性而非因果性的，但结果表明，穷人更易受极端高温影响，气候变化可能产生显著的分配和贫困影响。

title: Climate change through a poverty lens
Climate policies and nationally determined contributions: reconciling the needed ambition with the political economy
abstract: Countries have pledged to stabilize global warming at a 1.5 to 2°C increase. Either target requires reaching net zero emissions before the end of the century, which implies a major transformation of the economic system. This paper reviews the literature on how policymakers can design climate policies and their Nationally Determined Contributions (NDCs) to reach zero-net emissions before the end of the century in a socially and politically-acceptable manner. To get the ambition right, policymakers can use sectoral roadmaps with targets and indicators that track progress towards zero emissions (e.g. regarding renewable power or reforestation). Indeed, monitoring economy-wide emissions reductions alone would not ensure that short-term action contributes meaningfully to the long-term decarbonization goal. To get the political economy right, climate policies can be designed so that they contribute to non-climate objectives and create coalitions of supporters. For instance, revenues from carbon taxes can fund social assistance and infrastructure investment, while reducing tax evasion and informality. To minimize social and economic disruptions and avoid stranded assets, policymakers can start with a low carbon price level and use complementary policies. Designed at the sector level, complementary policies such as performance standards or feebates for cars, building norms, or moratoriums on new coal power plants can be negotiated in partnership with local stakeholders and trigger a transition to zero carbon without creating disruptive stranded assets.
abstract_zh: 各国已承诺将全球升温稳定在比工业化前水平升高1.5至2°C的范围内。无论是哪一目标，都要求在本世纪末之前实现净零排放，这意味着经济系统的重大转型。本文回顾了相关文献，探讨政策制定者如何以社会和政治上可接受的方式设计气候政策及其国家自主贡献（NDC），以在本世纪末之前实现净零排放。为把握合适的雄心水平，政策制定者可以使用带有目标和指标的部门路线图，以追踪迈向零排放的进展（例如在可再生电力或植树造林方面）。事实上，仅监测全经济范围的减排并不能确保短期行动对长期脱碳目标作出实质性贡献。为把握正确的政治经济学，气候政策可以设计为同时服务于非气候目标，并形成支持者联盟。例如，碳税收入可用于资助社会援助和基础设施投资，同时减少逃税和非正规经济。为尽量减少社会和经济动荡并避免搁浅资产，政策制定者可以从较低的碳价格水平开始，并辅以互补性政策。在部门层面设计的互补性政策，例如汽车的性能标准或“费率返还”（feebates）、建筑规范，或暂停新建燃煤电厂，可以与当地利益相关方协商推进，从而在不产生破坏性搁浅资产的情况下推动向零碳的转型。

title: Marginal abatement cost curves and the quality of emission reductions: a case study on Brazil
abstract: Decision makers facing emission-reduction targets need to decide which abatement measures to implement, and in which order. This article investigates how marginal abatement cost (MAC) curves can inform such a decision. We re-analyse a MAC curve built for Brazil by 2030, and show that misinterpreting MAC curves as abatement supply curves can lead to suboptimal strategies. It would lead to (1) under-investment in expensive, long-to-implement and large-potential options, such as clean transportation infrastructure, and (2) over-investment in cheap but limited-potential options such as energy-efficiency improvement in refineries. To mitigate this issue, the article proposes a new graphical representation of MAC curves that explicitly renders the time required to implement each measure. Policy relevance: In addition to the cost and potential of available options, designing optimal short-term policies requires information on long-term targets (e.g. halving emissions by 2050) and on the speed at which measures can deliver emission reductions. Mitigation policies are thus best investigated in a dynamic framework, building on sector-scale pathways to long-term targets. Climate policies should seek both quantity and quality of abatement, by combining two approaches: a ‘synergy approach’ that focuses on the cheapest mitigation options and maximizes co-benefits, and an ‘urgency approach’ that starts from a long-term objective and works backward to identify actions that need to be implemented early. Accordingly, sector-specific policies may be used (1) to remove implementation barriers on negative- and low-cost options and (2) to ensure short-term targets are met with abatement of sufficient quality. Indeed, such policies can avoid under-investment in the long-to-implement options required to reach long-term targets, which are otherwise difficult to enforce.
abstract_zh: 面对减排目标的决策者需要决定实施哪些减排措施，以及实施的先后顺序。本文探讨了边际减排成本（MAC）曲线如何为这一决策提供信息。我们重新分析了为巴西2030年目标构建的一条MAC曲线，并表明将MAC曲线误读为减排供给曲线可能导致次优战略。这可能导致（1）对成本高昂、实施周期长且减排潜力大的选项投资不足，例如清洁交通基础设施；（2）对成本低廉但潜力有限的选项投资过度，例如炼油厂的能效提升。为缓解这一问题，本文提出了一种新的MAC曲线图示方法，明确呈现实施每项措施所需的时间。政策相关性：除了可用选项的成本和潜力之外，设计最优的短期政策还需要了解长期目标（例如到2050年减排量减半）以及各项措施产生减排效果的速度。因此，减排政策最好在动态框架下进行研究，以通往长期目标的部门尺度路径为基础。气候政策应同时追求减排的数量与质量，将两种方法结合起来：一种是“协同方法”，着眼于最便宜的减排选项并最大化协同效益；另一种是“紧迫性方法”，从长期目标出发，倒推出需要尽早实施的行动。因此，部门特定政策可用于（1）消除成本为负或成本较低选项的实施障碍，以及（2）确保短期目标的实现具有足够质量的减排。事实上，此类政策可以避免在实现长期目标所需、但又难以强制执行的长周期实施选项上投资不足。

Modeling the Role of Inventories and Heterogeneity in the Assessment of the Economic Costs of Natural Disasters
abstract: Estimates of the cost of potential disasters, including indirect economic consequences, are an important input in the design of risk management strategies. The adaptive regional input‐output (ARIO) inventory model is a tool to assess indirect disaster losses and to analyze their drivers. It is based on an input‐output structure, but it also (i) explicitly represents production bottlenecks and input scarcity and (ii) introduces inventories as an additional flexibility in the production system. This modeling strategy distinguishes between (i) essential supplies that cannot be stocked (e.g., electricity, water) and whose scarcity can paralyze all economic activity; (ii) essential supplies that can be stocked at least temporarily (e.g., steel, chemicals), whose scarcity creates problems only over the medium term; and (iii) supplies that are not essential in the production process, whose scarcity is problematic only over the long run and are therefore easy to replace with imports. The model is applied to the landfall of Hurricane Katrina in Louisiana and identifies two periods in the disaster aftermath: (1) the first year, during which production bottlenecks are responsible for large output losses; (2) the rest of the reconstruction period, during which bottlenecks are inexistent and output losses lower. This analysis also suggests important research questions and policy options to mitigate disaster‐related output losses.
abstract_zh: 对潜在灾害成本（包括间接经济后果）的估计，是设计风险管理策略的重要输入。自适应区域投入产出（ARIO）库存模型是一种评估间接灾害损失并分析其驱动因素的工具。该模型以投入产出结构为基础，但同时（i）明确刻画了生产瓶颈和投入稀缺，并且（ii）引入库存作为生产系统中的额外灵活性。该建模策略区分了：（i）不能储存的基本供应品（例如电力、水），其稀缺会使所有经济活动陷入瘫痪；（ii）至少可以暂时储存的基本供应品（例如钢材、化学品），其稀缺仅在中期才会产生问题；以及（iii）在生产过程中并非必不可少的供应品，其稀缺仅在长期才成问题，因而很容易通过进口替代。该模型应用于飓风卡特里娜在路易斯安那州登陆的案例，识别出灾后的两个阶段：（1）第一年，生产瓶颈导致了大量产出损失；（2）重建期的其余时间，瓶颈不复存在，产出损失较低。该分析还提出了若干重要的研究问题和政策选项，以减轻与灾害相关的产出损失。

title: Funding low-carbon investments in the absence of a carbon tax
abstract: Introducing a carbon tax is difficult, partly because it suggests that current generations have to make sacrifices for the benefit of future generations. However, the climate change externality could be corrected without such a sacrifice. It is possible to set a carbon value, and use it to create ‘carbon certificates’ that can be accepted as part of commercial banks’ legal reserves. These certificates can be distributed to low-carbon projects, and be exchanged by investors against concessional loans, reducing capital costs for low-carbon projects. As the issuance of carbon certificates would increase the quantity of money, it will either lead to accelerated inflation or induce the Central Bank to raise interest rates. Low-carbon projects will thus have access to cheaper loans at the expense of either ‘regular’ investors (in case of higher interest rates) or of lenders and depositors (in case of accelerated inflation). Within this scheme, mitigation expenditures are compensated by a reduction in regular investments, so that immediate consumption is maintained. It uses future generation wealth to pay for a hedge against climate change. This framework is not as efficient as a carbon tax but is politically easier to implement and represents an interesting step in the trajectory towards a low-carbon economy.
abstract_zh: 开征碳税十分困难，部分原因在于它意味着当代人必须为子孙后代做出牺牲。然而，气候变化外部性本可在无需如此牺牲的情况下得到纠正。可以设定一个碳价值，并以此创建“碳证书”，使其可以作为商业银行法定准备金的一部分。这些证书可以分配给低碳项目，投资者则可以用其兑换优惠贷款，从而降低低碳项目的资本成本。由于碳证书的发行会增加货币供应量，它要么导致通胀加速，要么促使央行提高利率。因此，低碳项目将以“普通”投资者的利益为代价获得较便宜的贷款（在利率上升的情况下），或以贷款人和存款人的利益为代价（在通胀加速的情况下）。在该方案中，减缓支出通过减少普通投资得到补偿，因此当前消费得以维持。该方案动用的是未来世代的财富，以支付应对气候变化的“对冲”成本。该框架不如碳税有效，但在政治上更容易实施，并代表了迈向低碳经济轨道上一个有意义的步骤。

abstract: This article explores the critical role of labour market imperfections in climate stabilization cost formation, using a dynamic recursive energy—economy model that represents a second-best world with market imperfections and short-run adjustment constraints along a long-term growth path. The degree of rigidity of the labour markets is a central parameter, and a systematic sensitivity analysis of the model results confirms this. When labour markets are represented as highly flexible, the model results are in the usual range of the existing literature; that is, less than 2% GDP losses in 2030 for a stabilization target at 550 ppm CO2 equivalent. However, when labour market rigidities are accounted for, mitigation costs increase dramatically. Accompanying measures are identified, namely labour subsidies, which guarantee against the risk of large stabilization costs in the case of high rigidities of the labour markets. This complements the usual view that mitigation is a long-term matter that depends on technology, innovation, investment and behavioural change. The results support the view that mitigation is also a shorter-term issue and a matter of transition with regard to the labour market.
abstract_zh: 本文利用一个动态递归的能源—经济模型，探讨了劳动力市场不完善在气候稳定成本形成中的关键作用。该模型刻画了一个存在市场不完善和长期增长路径上短期调整约束的次优世界。劳动力市场的刚性程度是一个核心参数，对模型结果的系统敏感性分析证实了这一点。当劳动力市场被刻画为高度灵活时，模型结果处于现有文献的通常范围内，即：对于将二氧化碳当量浓度稳定在550ppm的目标，2030年的GDP损失不足2%。然而，当考虑到劳动力市场刚性时，减排成本会急剧上升。本文确定了配套措施，即劳动力补贴，它可以在劳动力市场刚性较高的情况下，防范巨大稳定成本的风险。这补充了通常的观点，即减缓气候变化是一个长期问题，取决于技术、创新、投资和行为转变。研究结果支持以下观点：减缓气候变化同样是一个较短期的问题，就劳动力市场而言，它是一个转型问题。
